instrument_device_family.label: Instrument / device family
instrument_device_family.value: Regenerative orthobiologics, including allografts and synthetic bone grafts, plus cervical, thoracolumbar and interbody spinal implant systems.

measurement_performance_specification.label: Measurement / performance specification
measurement_performance_specification.value: High reported fusion rates for biologics, biphasic growth factor release in OsteoFactor Pro, and a Trivium scaffold supporting vascularization and tissue ingrowth.

clinical_industrial_research_use.label: Clinical / industrial / research use
clinical_industrial_research_use.value: Bone grafting and spinal fusion, spinal fixation in complex, deformity and degenerative procedures, and wound healing.
